protocol.study: Matched direct, one-token and grammar-constrained JSON comparison
protocol.status: Specification before measured inference; local freeze, not independently registered
protocol.primary_systems_estimand: Across local items, median of per-item mean complete-loopback-HTTP latency difference, one_token minus direct; 5 repetitions retained within item.
protocol.secondary_systems_estimand: JSON minus direct paired latency, p50/p95, native phase timings, input/output token counts, decode API calls and failures.
protocol.quality_estimands: Per dataset classification accuracy for Choice/Noul. JSTS continuous gold: direct expected-stage MAE primary; all-mode hard-selected-stage MAE as a like-for-like secondary, with no fabricated stage classification target. Native one_token probability audit supports the same expectation as direct. No cross-dataset pooled accuracy.
protocol.local_selection: 150 previously published regression items: three per each of 45 generated families and five individually AI-authored items per each type. Hash-rank IDs using mini-jev-matched-v1: salt, independent of correctness. 50 items per type. Not a new held-out semantic test.
protocol.external_selection: 600 prespecified items in external_expanded protocol: JCoLA 200, JSTS 200, JCommonsenseQA 200. Raw text outside repository. Public development data, contamination unknown.
protocol.schedule: Seed 2026092053. Shuffle local plus external items in repetition 0, local only in repetitions 1-4. Shuffle all three condition orders independently within each item/repetition. Full schedule archived before inference.
protocol.request_count_semantics: Each request calls the helper once; JSON requests contain multiple llama_decode API calls, recorded separately in native decode_count.
protocol.warmup: Seven synthetic non-benchmark Choice inputs per mode (21 requests); all excluded from measured data.

modes.direct: Original repeat_typed_score formatter, candidate logits and stable softmax; no generated tokens.
modes.one_token: Identical complete tokenized prefix and candidates to direct; full-vocabulary mask then native greedy sampler, stop after selected label without EOS or another model forward call. Logits/probabilities retained as audit, not additional model work.
modes.json: Same state/instructions/options and repetition. Choice/Noul final output instruction replaced with compact JSON answer instruction; Score numeric JSON instruction retained but no prefilled assistant JSON prefix. Native GBNF emits only {answer: allowed string or number} with actual quotes/braces. Stop on completed allowed JSON object, max 32 tokens; no extra EOS decode. Different complete prompts mean this is a structured-answer system comparison, not isolated sampling overhead.

protocol.response_functionality: Measured HTTP response is identical type+semantic-label schema in every mode. Numerical probabilities and native traces are retained server-side and written after request timing. Direct distribution/ordinal expectation utility is reported separately from hard-label generation.

temperature.fitting: none; no new calibration or prompt tuning

protocol.parity: direct/one_token must have identical prompt hashes/token hashes/candidate IDs; compare label equality and logits at absolute tolerance 1e-5. Record violations; do not discard cases. Exact ties with different native tie policy are separately counted.
protocol.timing: time.perf_counter from client JSON serialization through HTTP body read and parse, single persistent loopback connection with TCP_NODELAY on the server socket, no concurrency. Identical common research server builds prompts and calls a single resident helper. Native stages separately reported. It is not a production-server or remote-network benchmark.
protocol.runtime: One pinned Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M model, llama.cpp f072b103714dfa1eee531f80b24512faf38e3dd2, M5 Pro 64 GB, Metal, six threads, 2048 token context, state cleared per request, no prompt cache or concurrent GPU workload.
protocol.failure_policy: Retain every selected request and errors, never replace/exclude/truncate. Structural or transport implementation bugs require an explicitly recorded invalidated attempt and new complete freeze; any result-informed prompt change becomes development and requires fresh test material.
protocol.uncertainty: Local paired latency: mean 5 repetitions within item then 10000 whole-family/tag bootstrap draws preserving items and conditions; conditional percentile interval, not hardware-population guarantee. External descriptive metrics and paired condition differences only; semantic groups and overlaps disclosed, no IID sample confidence claim.
limitations: Single model, single machine and same-session measurements
Published local items are regression/development material
External datasets are public and may be in pretraining
JSON has a different serialization-specific prompt and no model probability vector
Head-training effectiveness is outside this controlled-readout study

note: Locally timestamped protocol freeze; not independent public preregistration.
